name: canvas-lms
description: Use Canvas LMS course, assignment, grading, quiz, page, rubric, and file tools from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Manage courses, grading, quizzes, and content.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to Canvas LMS for course administration, assignments, grading, quizzes, pages, modules, rubrics, files, and analytics. Student data is anonymized by default in supported tools.
defaultPrompt: Show the missing-work report for a course.
